items.name: UserDefinedLogicalNode
items.summary: This defines the interface for [`LogicalPlan`] nodes that can be used to extend DataFusion with custom relational operators.

methods.name: as_any
methods.summary: Return a reference to self as Any, to support dynamic downcasting

methods.name: check_invariants
methods.summary: Perform check of invariants for the extension node.

methods.name: dyn_eq
methods.summary: Compare `other`, respecting requirements from [Eq].

methods.name: dyn_hash
methods.summary: Update the hash `state` with this node requirements from [`Hash`].

methods.name: dyn_ord
methods.summary: Compare `other`, respecting requirements from [PartialOrd]. Must return `Some(Equal)` if and only if `self.dyn_eq(other)`.

methods.name: expressions
methods.summary: Returns all expressions in the current logical plan node. This should not include expressions of any inputs (aka non-recursively).

methods.name: fmt_for_explain
methods.summary: Write a single line, human readable string to `f` for use in explain plan.

methods.name: inputs
methods.summary: Return the logical plan's inputs.

methods.name: name
methods.summary: Return the plan's name.

methods.name: necessary_children_exprs
methods.summary: Returns the necessary input columns for this node required to compute the columns in the output schema

methods.name: prevent_predicate_push_down_columns
methods.summary: A list of output columns (e.g. the names of columns in self.schema()) for which predicates can not be pushed below this node without changing the output.

methods.name: schema
methods.summary: Return the output schema of this logical plan node.

methods.name: supports_limit_pushdown
methods.summary: Returns `true` if a limit can be safely pushed down through this `UserDefinedLogicalNode` node.

methods.name: with_exprs_and_inputs
methods.signature: fn with_exprs_and_inputs(&self, exprs: Vec<Expr>, inputs: Vec<LogicalPlan>) -> Result<Arc<dyn UserDefinedLogicalNode>>
methods.summary: Create a new `UserDefinedLogicalNode` with the specified children and expressions. This function is used during optimization when the plan is being rewritten and a new instance of the `UserDefinedLogicalNode` must be created.
